Lemma
[Critical Morrey potential estimate] 1. ch7:7.20\group ch07-sobolev-spacesSource: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0177, gilbarg-trudinger:page-0178 Let $p>1$, $f\in M^p(\Omega )$, $\mu =p^{-1}$, and $g=V_\mu f$. There are $c_1,c_2>0$, depending only on $n,p$, such that, for $K=\| f\| _{M^p(\Omega )}$, \begin{equation} \tag {7.50} \int _\Omega \exp \! \left(\frac{|g|}{c_1K}\right)dx \leq c_2(\diam \Omega )^n. \end{equation}
Proof

\sketch Factor the potential kernel and apply Hölder’s inequality to bound $|g|$ by powers of $V_{\mu /q}|f|$ and $V_{\mu +\mu /q}|f|$. Lemmas 7.12 and 7.18 give $\int _\Omega |g|^q\leq C\{ (p-1)qK\} ^q(\diam \Omega )^n$. Summing moments proves (7.50) when $c_1>(p-1)e$.

□
